evidence.name: Screen field: Text area in each card
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Text area in each card" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Text area in each card
sections.description: On grid cards with an image, this sets the title-and-subtitle region as a block: where it sits in the card, how tall it is (a fixed height or sized to fit its content), and the spacing around it. It fits the content by default, but choosing one fixed height keeps the text blocks aligned across every card so the row reads as a clean, scannable set. This controls the text region's position only; the actual fonts and colors of the title and subtitle are set in their own style sections.
